description: Diagnostic-only probe for write_service staleness (heartbeat age 45m >300s threshold). Do NOT propose rebuild of write_service (protected). Instead, create a diagnostic that: (1) calls write_service health endpoint to confirm responsiveness; (2) queries service_health for write_service last_heartbeat and age; (3) checks for recent service_restart events in audit_log; (4) emits a structured diagnostic report with severity assessment (STALE vs DEAD vs HEALTHY). Report should be written to /tmp/write_service_diagnostic.json. This file will be reviewed by human operators. Do NOT auto-restart or auto-repair. Do NOT issue DELETE or DROP on any table.
